step.code:
<?php

namespace App\Helpers;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ErrorHandler
{
    /**
     * Report an exception with contextual data.
     *
     * @param \Throwable $e
     * @param array<string, mixed> $context
     * @return void
     */
    public static function report(\Throwable $e, array $context = []): void
    {
        Log::error($e->getMessage(), array_merge($context, [
            'file'  => $e->getFile(),
            'line'  => $e->getLine(),
            'trace' => array_slice($e->getTrace(), 0, 5),
        ]));
    }

    /**
     * Report and optionally rethrow.
     *
     * @param \Throwable $e
     * @param array<string, mixed> $context
     * @param bool $rethrow
     * @return void
     * @throws \Throwable
     */
    public static function handle(\Throwable $e, array $context = [], bool $rethrow = false): void
    {
        static::report($e, $context);
        if ($rethrow) {
            throw $e;
        }
    }
}

step.description: Define the table, column, and attempt limit.
Generate UUID and verify no collision in target table.
Full seeder with console output, clock limiter, and error handling.
step.code:
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleOutput;
use App\Helpers\ErrorHandler;

class ExampleSeeder extends Seeder
{
    private ConsoleOutput $output;
    private const MAX_SECONDS  = 300;
    private const HARD_CAP     = 512; // complexity 1

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->output = new ConsoleOutput();
    }

    public function run(): void
    {
        $start    = microtime(true);
        $created  = 0;

        try {
            while ($created < self::HARD_CAP) {
                $elapsed = microtime(true) - $start;
                if ($elapsed >= self::MAX_SECONDS) {
                    Log::info("Clock limit reached", [
                        'seeder'  => static::class,
                        'created' => $created,
                        'elapsed' => round($elapsed, 2),
                    ]);
                    break;
                }

                // Generate unique code
                $attempts = 0;
                do {
                    $code = strtoupper(Str::random(8));
                    $exists = DB::selectOne(
                        "SELECT 1 FROM examples WHERE code = ? LIMIT 1",
                        [$code]
                    );
                    $attempts++;
                } while ($exists && $attempts < 50);

                $this->output->writeln("<info>Creating example #{$created}: {$code}</info>");

                DB::table('examples')->insert([
                    'id'         => (string) Str::uuid(),
                    'code'       => $code,
                    'created_at' => now(),
                    'updated_at' => now(),
                ]);

                $created++;
            }

            Log::info("Seeder completed", [
                'seeder'  => static::class,
                'created' => $created,
                'elapsed' => round(microtime(true) - $start, 2),
            ]);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            ErrorHandler::report($e, ['seeder' => static::class]);
        }
    }
}
